hypotheses.text: If Ruben Saldo (CB) had been 3 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the chance-to-score on that shot would have been meaningfully reduced and could plausibly have prevented the goal.
If Kofi Asante-Rhys (LB) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the tighter pressure from the flank would have lowered the shot quality and decreased the chance-to-score.
If Lukas Hagen (CB) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, additional central coverage would have limited the space and angle for the shot, reducing the probability of a goal.
